security_procurement.zh: 丹麦科技大学AI治理框架提出了负责任应用AI的通用建议；具体的学校IT采购合同及供应商风险合规责任属于未核实缺口。
security_procurement.meaningEn: DTU AI Governance recommendations (IT procurement unverified)
security_procurement.meaningZh: 全校AI治理建议（IT采购合同未核实）

do.en: Always indicate when and how AI tools were used in coursework and cite sources properly.
do.zh: 在课程作业中始终如实说明AI的使用方式并规范标注引注出处。

do.en: Check the course and examination instructions to establish when AI is allowed.
do.zh: 核对课程和考试说明，确认何时允许使用AI。

dont.en: Check the course and examination instructions to establish when AI is allowed.
dont.zh: 核对课程和考试说明，确认何时允许使用AI。

dont.en: Consult the DTU Library guide when referencing generative AI.
dont.zh: 引用生成式AI时查阅丹麦技术大学图书馆指南。

coursework:dtu-coursework-permitted-grou.text: DTU permits AI use in studies provided students clearly indicate when and how tools were used and adhere to citation rules.
coursework:dtu-coursework-permitted-grou.summaryZh: 全校允许作业中使用AI但须明确说明并规范引注

evidence.quote: The answer is yes, as long as students clearly indicate when and how they are utilizing AI. It’s essential to follow the rules for proper citation when using generative AI.
evidence.location: Can students use AI in their studies?

exams:dtu-exams-courses-group.text: DTU says AI is currently allowed in some courses and exams.
exams:dtu-exams-courses-group.summaryZh: 部分开网考试试点允许AI且需结合批判性思维

evidence.quote: AI is currently allowed in some courses and exams. In these courses, learning objectives are adjusted to accommodate AI usage, and the exam format assumes that students can master critical thinking skills.
evidence.location: Can student use AI in their exams?

disclosure:dtu-disclosure-library-group.text: DTU Library provides a referencing guide for generative AI that includes links to the code of honour.
disclosure:dtu-disclosure-library-group.summaryZh: 图书馆提供引注指南并将透明度与荣誉守则绑定
disclosure:dtu-disclosure-library-group.scope: DTU Library citation guide and honor code

evidence.quote: The library has created a guide for referencing when using generative AI, which also includes links to DTU’s code of honour.

privacy_data:dtu-privacy-copilot-group.text: When content is subject to GDPR or critical to DTU operations or individuals, the guidance says to consider using Copilot for the web.
privacy_data:dtu-privacy-copilot-group.summaryZh: 涉及GDPR个人数据或关键运营时建议使用Copilot

evidence.quote: If the content is subject to GDPR or is critical for DTU’s operations or individuals, consider using Copilot for the web. It’s a Microsoft AI solution built on ChatGPT 4.0.
evidence.location: What’s important to know when choosing an AI tool?

approved_tools:dtu-tools-open-group.text: DTU does not operate a closed restrictive tool whitelist, instead emphasizing common sense, honor code, and clear attribution.
approved_tools:dtu-tools-open-group.summaryZh: 未设封闭工具白名单但在合规透明前提下开放使用

evidence.quote: Currently, DTU does not have rules regarding which AI tools are allowed or prohibited. However, they emphasize common sense, awareness of DTU’s honor code, and clear source attribution.
evidence.location: Which AI tools are allowed at DTU?

research_publication:dtu-research-integr.text: Integrity guidelines emphasize transparency in research proposal preparation; comprehensive publication authorship rules remain an unverified policy gap.
research_publication:dtu-research-integr.summaryZh: 科研规范要求如实陈述AI工具在提案中的局限性

evidence.quote: Acknowledge the limitations of the AI tool in the proposal preparation, including the potential for bias, errors, and gaps in knowledge.
evidence.location: Living guidelines on responsible use in research

academic_integrity:dtu-integrity-sanctio.text: DTU disciplinary regulations provide formal sanction options for violations of examination rules.
academic_integrity:dtu-integrity-sanctio.summaryZh: 考试违规追究依照校级纪律处分条例严肃处理
academic_integrity:dtu-integrity-sanctio.scope: DTU examination cheating rules and sanctions

evidence.quote: DTU har følgende reaktions- og sanktionsmuligheder ved overtrædelse af eksamensregler, jf. DTU's disciplinærregler over for studerende:

teaching_guidance:dtu-teaching-embrace-g.text: DTU encourages teachers to embrace generative AI in designing teaching materials and adjusting course learning objectives.
teaching_guidance:dtu-teaching-embrace-g.summaryZh: 鼓励教师重构教学设计将AI有机融入课程体系

evidence.quote: Teachers are encouraged to use AI when designing their teaching materials. Embracing AI provides an opportunity to rethink the role of teaching, combining technical knowledge, pedagogical expertise, and awareness of the latest advancements in the field.
evidence.location: Can teachers use AI when designing their teaching materials?

security_procurement:dtu-procurement-gov.text: The governance framework outlines aims for responsible AI usage; specific vendor procurement duties remain an unverified gap.
security_procurement:dtu-procurement-gov.summaryZh: 全校推进AI治理战略项目以建立综合合规框架
security_procurement:dtu-procurement-gov.scope: DTU AI Governance recommendations (IT procurement unverified)

evidence.quote: The project aims to develop a common framework that identifies guidelines, recommendations, and strategies for AI Governance.
